repos_data.description: MCP server for the Live Tennis API. Gives LLM agents in Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients real-time tennis scores, odds and model win-probability.
Official TypeScript & Python SDKs + MCP integration for the Lumify sports-intelligence API: schedules, live scores, odds, betting splits, and explainable bet confidence.
MCP server for the Flash Props API: player props, normalized markets, line movement, and projections across sports and esports, in Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. Free tier, no scraping.
